title: Bad Luck Grand Prix
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro Mouri, Conan, Detective Takagi, Officer Okumura) omitted by convention -- background police presence only. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. case_type: attempted_murder (both victims survive). Discrepancy vs. old cases/ep475 file: the old file names the crime scene 'Rice Flower Park'; the transcript states 'Beika Park' explicitly (line: 'The place is Beika Park, in the back street') -- transcript wins, corrected to Beika Park here. The old file's culprit attribution (s2/Ichikura Tomomi) matches the transcript correctly, so no culprit discrepancy there. The old file collapsed the plot into three generic `event` nodes and a single `knows` edge for both suspects toward the victim; rebuilt here with specific verbs (runs_down/steals/threatens/plants/attempts_to_suffocate), the real motive chain (Ichikura wanted Okonogi's inheritance via her fiance Kazuma, used the unlucky bystander Tatematsu as cover since he was seen with Okonogi daily), and the fabricated-alibi mechanism (a self-planted fake bomb scare at Tohto Department Store, timed to look like she was in Ginza during the hit-and-run).

attrs.nickname_origin: TV segment made by his nephew about his chronic bad luck
attrs.routine: walks home from Beika Station and exchanges greetings with Okonogi, who is out on a leisurely walk, most evenings

attrs.family: no immediate family besides his nephew Kazuma
attrs.outcome: survives the hit-and-run and a later hospital attack, regains consciousness

attrs.alibi: claims he went home sick at noon and slept alone; no witness
attrs.note: red herring: sole heir and in debt to Okonogi, but had no role in the plot

attrs.stated_motive: wanted Okonogi's inheritance money once she married Kazuma; unwilling to wait for him to die naturally

attrs.detail: back street where Tatematsu and Okonogi cross paths each evening

attrs.status: reported stolen, license plate seen by a witness, car itself never recovered

attrs.actual_location: moved to men's restroom, 6th floor by a child who was shopping, before being found
attrs.purpose: manufacture a public commotion at a predictable time to fake an alibi

attrs.contents: expensive meat and sashimi, plus items revealing his name and home address
attrs.significance: let Ichikura learn Tatematsu's identity so she could threaten him and later use him as cover

attrs.used_for: attempted suffocation of the unconscious Okonogi in his hospital bed
attrs.found: Ichikura tried to hide it when interrupted

attrs.content: message to Kazuma describing a bomb-scare commotion at the department store, claimed to be sent from the scene
attrs.sent_time: 6:40 PM, ten minutes after the reported commotion

clues.desc: Ichikura's alibi text says the bomb was found on the 5th floor women's restroom, but police confirm it was actually discovered on the 6th floor men's restroom -- proves she never witnessed the commotion in person and only knew about it because she planted it herself.
